newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyo Comm down as broker maintains rating.
newsitem.headline: Toyo Comm down as broker maintains rating.

text.p: Toyo Communications Equipment Co Ltd shares fell in Wednesday afternoon trade as investors were discouraged by a brokerage's decision not to upgrade the firm's rating, brokers said.
As of 0535 GMT, the shares were down 250 yen at 2,030 yen.
Nomura Research Institute Ltd decided to maintain Toyo Communications rating at "3", Nomura Securities brokers said on Wednesday.

In its three-grade rating system, the research institute assigns a "3" rating to issues whose values it sees underperforming the 225-share Nikkei average by more than 10 percentage points over the following six months.
